subject: SIG evidence request: secure SDLC artifacts for Acme Retail
messages:
From: Lisa Buxton <lisa.buxton@acme-retail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-retail.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request: secure SDLC artifacts for Acme Retail evaluation

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security team is starting a SIG assessment for vendor onboarding and has asked for a compact evidence bundle focused on your secure SDLC controls. Can you provide the following artifacts by next Wednesday (10 business days):

- Code review evidence (PR audit log, reviewer matrix, sample PRs showing gating)
- CI/CD controls (pipeline YAML, runner permissions, secrets scanning config)
- Secrets management details (KMS/HSM usage, rotation cadence, access approval process)
- Change management approvals and emergency change process notes

If possible, please upload to the shared Drive folder linked below and send the link when ready. We prefer redacted artifacts rather than full production secrets.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-evidence-acme-2027

Let me know if that timeline works and if you need a scoped list rather than everything.

Best,
Lisa
Acme Retail - Vendor Security
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG evidence request: secure SDLC artifacts for Acme Retail evaluation

Team,

Forwarding Acme's ask. We need a concise package — redacted artifacts, not raw secrets. Proposed split of work:

- Monica: export PR audit for the last 12 months, include reviewer assignments and a sample of gated PRs. Please produce an index CSV and a zipped sample (no source blobs).
- Rishi: CI/CD pipeline evidence. Export the annotated pipeline YAML, list of runners with permission scopes, and the secrets scanning policy output for the last 30 days. Include how we enforce pipeline gating for release branches.
- Markus: KMS/HSM usage and rotation. Provide a short narrative of KMS key policies, the rotation log CSV, and who approves key use for deploys.

Attachments: evidence-collection-checklist.xlsx (checklist to track artifacts and redaction status). Upload everything to the Drive link and drop the link here. We must sign off internally before sharing.

Deadline: EOD Monday, 24 May 2027 so we can review and send to Acme. If any item is not possible, call it out now.

Jonas
VP, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG evidence request: secure SDLC artifacts for Acme Retail evaluation

Jonas,

Acknowledged. I'll pull the PR audit from our code-hosting analytics and produce:

- pr-audit-202705.zip (index.csv + redacted PR exports, reviewer matrix)
- sample-gated-prs.md (4 PRs demonstrating protected branch gating)

I'll avoid exporting full diffs or any secrets. Upload ETA: Friday 21 May by 6pm PT to the Drive link. Linking the Jira ticket I've opened for this work: https://acme.jira.com/browse/SEC-4821

Monica
Engineering Manager, Secure Platform
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG evidence request: secure SDLC artifacts for Acme Retail evaluation

Quick status update:

- Attached: ci-pipeline-annotated.yml (pipeline steps annotated with gating and secrets usage)
- Exported secrets-scan-output.csv for the last 30 days (remediations flagged)
- Runner-permissions-summary.md (lists service account scopes used by self-hosted runners)

I sanitized any environment variable values and replaced them with placeholders. The secrets scan export contains matched findings; I'll include a short readme describing what each column means. Uploading to Drive now.

Rishi
Senior SRE
From: Lisa Buxton <lisa.buxton@acme-retail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-retail.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request: secure SDLC artifacts for Acme Retail evaluation

Jonas,

Thanks for the quick coordination and the planned artifacts. Two quick asks from our side before you upload: please ensure the annotated pipeline YAML calls out the runner identity and where secrets are referenced, and in the KMS rotation log include the key IDs and rotation timestamps (no key material). If you could also map each artifact to the SIG control it addresses (short table), that would speed review on our end.

We'll start a parallel SOC 2 crosswalk but the SIG evidence you provide will cover most of our questions.

Appreciate it,
Lisa
